patch:
diff --git a/pylint/checkers/similar.py b/pylint/checkers/similar.py
index c65b1c89..3b39c3a7 100644
--- a/pylint/checkers/similar.py
+++ b/pylint/checkers/similar.py
@@ -817,6 +817,9 @@ class SimilarChecker(BaseChecker, Similar, MapReduceMixin):
         self.stats = self.linter.add_stats(
             nb_duplicated_lines=0, percent_duplicated_lines=0
         )
+        if self.min_lines == 0:
+            # `min-similarity-lines` set to 0 disables the duplicate code check
+            self.linter.disable("R0801")
 
     def process_module(self, node):
         """process a module
@@ -825,6 +828,8 @@ class SimilarChecker(BaseChecker, Similar, MapReduceMixin):
 
         stream must implement the readlines method
         """
+        if self.min_lines == 0:
+            return
         with node.stream() as stream:
             self.append_stream(self.linter.current_name, stream, node.file_encoding)
